During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], an '''assassination attempt''' was made on [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Thranz]] and [[Falit]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ardun Kothe]] rescued the Senators during the attempt, and the politicians escaped without harm.
